Class Repl

java.lang.Object
org.clafer.ig.Repl
public final class Repl extends Object
The one loop of the solutions, whatever the backend: claferIG's CommandLine.hs, with clafersg's commands. A solution is an instance (Choco) or a trace (Alloy). The loop keeps the solutions shown, the most recent first, and their views: the full view or the diff view (d), the saved files (e), the Graphviz graph (dot) and the clafers found (f); the backend solves and handles its own commands.
